selection: Purposive contrast of eight resources, not an effectiveness ranking or exhaustive tutorial review

tutorials.title: Haskell MOOC
tutorials.venue: University of Helsinki / Nitor course website
tutorials.inspection: Index; Part 1 contents; sections 1.12–1.14, 1.9, 3.2; selected examples
tutorials.limits: No logged-in submission or full-platform accessibility audit; assessment policy is observed design, not learning evidence

tutorials.title: Haskell Programming from First Principles
tutorials.inspection: Website contents and author rationale; selected chapter 2 exercises, sections 2.10–2.11, in 96-page public sample
tutorials.limits: Full book not inspected; chapter 1 absent from public sample; author instructional claims are not measured learning outcomes

tutorials.title: Programming in Haskell, second edition
tutorials.venue: Cambridge University Press; author University of Nottingham website
tutorials.discovery: Scope-named resource; direct official author-site inspection
tutorials.inspection: Author description, table of contents, exercise/resource availability
tutorials.limits: Metadata/contents inspection only; chapter prose, exercise text, solutions, videos, and exams uninspected

tutorials.title: CIS 194: Introduction to Haskell, Spring 2013
tutorials.discovery: Scope-named resource; direct official university-site inspection
tutorials.inspection: Course description, schedule, revision/grading policy, homework 4, selected laziness and IO lecture sections
tutorials.limits: Archived offering; prerequisites not verified; no actual student submissions or feedback inspected; embedded laziness lecture date says 2012 despite Spring 2013 archive

tutorials.title: Learn You a Haskell for Great Good! (maintained community fork)
tutorials.discovery: Scope-named resource; original domain failed; successor direct inspection
tutorials.inspection: Fork provenance statement, introduction, contents, selected currying/higher-order chapter sections
tutorials.limits: Inspected fork, not original edition; original learnyouahaskell.com and www.learnyouahaskell.com requests timed out

tutorials.title: Haskell Wikibook
tutorials.inspection: Contents, selected fold explanations and exercises, selected simple IO discussion
tutorials.limits: Community document with multiple routes; linked solutions not independently inspected; no platform-wide audit

tutorials.title: CodeWorld and CodeWorld Haskell
tutorials.discovery: Scope-named resource; official site and project repository/API documentation
tutorials.inspection: README variants and mission; live application's exposed controls; standard Haskell API drawing/animation/activity examples; educational core types
tutorials.limits: CodeWorld educational dialect is distinct from standard Haskell mode; guide/doc.html and guide.html failed; no course sequence, independent exercises, or assessment verified

tutorials.title: Exercism Haskell track
tutorials.discovery: Scope-named resource; direct official platform inspection
tutorials.inspection: Public track summary, practice listing, Leap specification and examples
tutorials.limits: No logged-in runner, automated analysis, or mentoring interaction inspected; advertised features distinguished from observed feedback; prerequisite knowledge not verified

semantic_authorities.title: Haskell 2010 Report, chapter 4: Declarations and Bindings
Haskell 2010 Report, chapter 6: Predefined Types and Classes
semantic_authorities.inspection: Tuple, IO, non-strict/seq, Monad declarations and laws
semantic_authorities.limits: Historical class hierarchy; do-pattern failure translation predates MonadFail

semantic_authorities.title: Haskell 2010 Report, chapter 7: Basic Input/Output
semantic_authorities.inspection: Action sequencing, IO function signatures, return discussion

semantic_authorities.title: Control.DeepSeq, GHC-bundled deepseq 1.4.1.1 source documentation
semantic_authorities.inspection: seq/deepseq comparison, NFData Int/list instances, ordering disclaimer
semantic_authorities.limits: Historical explicitly versioned source; no latest-version claim

semantic_authorities.title: GHC User's Guide: Using GHCi
semantic_authorities.limits: Moving latest URL; version should be pinned in teaching material

diagnostic_status: Twelve reviewer-proposed diagnostics derived from inspected authoritative definitions; no compiler execution and no empirical prevalence claim
